messages:
Aisha Khan: Heads up — noticed ~120 leads in `Inbound` unassigned during PST 00:00–06:00 last night. Looks like enrichment TTL expired before round-robin ran. spreadsheet: https://go/redwood/leads/sheet
Tom Li: saw that too. HubSpot logs show the enrichment webhook returned 504s at 01:14 and workflow didn't enqueue retries.
Becky Ramos: Quiet hours rule probably bumped priority to 'low' and round-robin job skips low-priority. We added that rule in Q1. Suggest: allow fastlane for MQL tag regardless of quiet hours.
Ravi Patel: Agree. Quick patch: change RR task filter from `priority != low` to `priority not in ["spam","manual-hold"]`. Minimal risk.
hubspot-bot: Alert: workflow 'enrich-and-route-v2' failed 35 events (01:10-01:20) — see logs: https://go/redwood/logs/hs/enrich-v2
Tom Li: If we rollout Ravi's patch we'll need to backfill the 120 leads. I can run a safe re-enqueue script.
Becky Ramos: Also add a heartbeat and TTL extension — set enrichment TTL to 6h when webhook errors seen. Something like:
```
if webhook_status >= 500:
  enrichment_ttl = max(enrichment_ttl, now + 6h)
```
Tom Li: I can add that to the workflow's retry action. Will test in staging.
Aisha Khan: Action items:
- Ravi: PR to RR filter (rollout: canary to 10%)
- Tom: backfill script + staging test
- Becky: update workflow TTL logic + QA

Please ping #eng-ml if you need help. Target: patch live by EOD tomorrow PST.
Ravi Patel: I'll open the PR now: https://go/redwood/pr/4242
Becky Ramos: I'll pair with Tom tomorrow 9am PST for validation.
Tom Li: Backfill started (id: backfill-20200816-01). ETA ~20m.
hubspot-bot: Backfill complete — 120 leads reassigned. Duration: 18m.
Aisha Khan: Awesome. Monitor for next 24h and report any reoccurrence. :thumbsup:
